issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'יְחִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ' means 'May the king live!' (a cheer for the king), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Cầu Đức Giê-hô-va sống!' ('May the LORD live!'), which incorrectly substitutes 'the king' with 'the LORD' (Đức Giê-hô-va), changing the meaning and adding a divine reference not present in the Hebrew.
